title: A Crow Keeps Saying My Name #shorts #horror
description: A CreepyCartoonTales story. What would you do? Tell us in the comments.
lines: Imagine a crow sits on your fence every morning. You feed it toast.
One day, it tilts its head and says your name.
The next day it says, "Don't cross the road."
You stop. A truck flies through the red light, right where you'd be.
That night, it taps on your window.
*It speaks in your dad's voice. "Let me in. It's cold."
Your dad has been gone for three years.
You open the window. Of course you do.
It knows your secret handshake. It laughs his laugh.
"Let me in," it says. "All the way." It flies into your chest.
You wake up on the fence. Small. Black. Feathers. And inside, you're eating toast.
